sourceText:
Great Ball Of Fire
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, November 30, 2009 - 11:33pm

Ingredients




4 1/4 ounces Underwood deviled ham spread, canned
3 ounces Cream cheese, softened
1 cup Shredded cheddar cheese
3 tablespoons Old el paso chopped green chiles
2 tablespoons Finely chopped green onions, if desired
 cup Chopped walnuts

Preparation

1 In small bowl, combine ham spread, cream cheese, Cheddar cheese, chiles and onions; mix well. 2 Shape mixture into ball. Roll in walnuts. Wrap in plastic wrap; refrigerate 2 hours. 3 Let ball stand at room temperature for 30 minutes to soften slightly before serving. 4 Serve with crackers. 5 2 cups 6 ROARING SUCCESS: A Hot New Appetizer for Your Holiday Get-Togethers. Add spark to your holiday parties and gatherings with this easy-to-make lively spread. This simple new appetizer idea is perfect for holiday entertaining, and is sure to be a crowd favorite.
